shortDefinition: An unguessable link that grants scoped access to a Pearl or resource in Melusina.

children.text: Capability URLs (grain links) carry the rights to access a specific Pearl or resource. They replace global usernames/passwords with explicit, shareable capabilities. Melusina supports four grain link modes:
Burn-after-reading: single session—allows refresh within the same tab, but once the tab closes the link is consumed.
Timed: absolute expiration—access valid until a specific datetime, then permanently revoked.
Use-count: atomic counter—each access decrements the count via findAndModify. Zero remaining = revoked.
Unlimited: no expiry—valid until manually revoked or the grain is deleted.

For NFT-backed grains, the URL token's SHA-256 hash is stored on-chain via a Solana PDA derived from ["grain_registry", licenseMint, sha256(grainId)]. This enables on-chain proof that a specific grain link exists and is valid.
